description: Invoke any action a tool exposes (see list_tool_actions) and return its result. This is the generic escape hatch that works for every Buoy tool.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out. Or "All" to broadcast.

params.description: JSON params object for the action (shape depends on the action).

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for the device's result.

name: call_action
